title: TaxAI production runtime configuration (spec 016 T01)
description: The closed set of App Service application settings for the production Portal. Every key is required and no other key is permitted; values are infrastructure identifiers and policy constants, never secrets or taxpayer data. Key names use the App Service double-underscore form of the TaxAi:Production:* configuration keys validated by TaxAI.AzureInfrastructure.ProductionConfigurationValidator. Passing this schema is necessary and never sufficient: the Portal admission gate also verifies registrations, the issued managed identity, the exact artifact version and the release evidence.

TaxAi__Production__Environment.description: Exact host environment; there is no enable switch.

TaxAi__Production__PrimaryRegion.description: Primary region for all normal-operation resources (FR-01).

TaxAi__Production__TenantId.description: Entra tenant of the managed identity.

TaxAi__Production__ResourceGroup.description: Resource group holding the approved inventory.

TaxAi__Production__ArtifactVersion.description: Exact artifact version; must equal the running build's informational version.

TaxAi__Production__DocumentIntelligence_.description: Document Intelligence custom-subdomain resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.
Document Intelligence custom-subdomain resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.
Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).
Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__SourceStorage__Endpoi.description: Source content storage account resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

TaxAi__Production__SourceStorage__Resour.description: Source content storage account resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

TaxAi__Production__SourceStorage__Region.description: Source content storage account region: canadacentral for the Primary profile; canadaeast only with CanadaEastRecovery (the offline check and the validator bind the two).

TaxAi__Production__SourceStorage__Public.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__SourceStorage__Privat.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__KeyVault__Endpoint.description: Key Vault resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

TaxAi__Production__KeyVault__ResourceId.description: Key Vault resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

TaxAi__Production__KeyVault__PublicNetwo.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__KeyVault__PrivateEndp.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__Sql__Endpoint.description: Azure SQL logical server resource-specific endpoint; must be the named resource's own host.

TaxAi__Production__Sql__ResourceId.description: Azure SQL logical server resource id in the configured subscription and resource group.

TaxAi__Production__Sql__Region.description: Azure SQL logical server region: canadacentral for the Primary profile; canadaeast only with CanadaEastRecovery (the offline check and the validator bind the two).

TaxAi__Production__Sql__PublicNetworkAcc.description: Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__Sql__PrivateEndpoint.description: Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__SourceEnvelope__KeyUr.description: Versionless Key Vault key wrapping per-content source keys; in the configured vault.

TaxAi__Production__DataProtection__Stora.description: Control storage account for the key ring; must differ from source storage.

TaxAi__Production__DataProtection__KeyUr.description: Versionless Key Vault key wrapping the key ring; distinct from the source envelope key.

TaxAi__Production__DataProtection__Appli.description: Discriminator shared only by intended production instances.

TaxAi__Production__Resilience__Operation.description: [ASSUMED] finite operation deadline, greater than zero and at most 00:10:00.

TaxAi__Production__Resilience__ProbeDead.description: [ASSUMED] finite identity-probe deadline, greater than zero and at most 00:01:00.

TaxAi__Production__EvidenceManifest.description: Release evidence manifest JSON conforming to specs/016-canadian-azure-production-infrastructure/contracts/production-evidence.schema.json. Never contains a secret.

TaxAi__Extraction__Provider.description: The only production provider name. No adapter ships in T01, so admission stays refused.

TaxAi__Extraction__ContentReader.description: The only production reader name. No adapter ships in T01, so admission stays refused.

ConnectionStrings__TaxAiDatabase.description: Managed-identity SQL connection with strict encryption. Carries no password.

TaxAi__Production__Recovery__Profile.description: Spec 016 T06: Primary for the Canada Central host; CanadaEastRecovery only for the manually activated Canada East recovery host (a separately signed configuration). Document Intelligence, Key Vault and monitoring never move.

TaxAi__Production__Recovery__ControlLedg.description: Spec 016 T06: the recovery control ledger's Canada Central copy; the account's own Blob endpoint, distinct from every other storage account.
Spec 016 T06: the resource id of the control ledger's Canada Central copy in the configured subscription and resource group.
Spec 016 T06: the control ledger's Canada Central copy region.
Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).
Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).
Spec 016 T06: the recovery control ledger's authoritative, independently recoverable Canada East copy; the account's own Blob endpoint, distinct from every other storage account.
Spec 016 T06: the resource id of the control ledger's authoritative, independently recoverable Canada East copy in the configured subscription and resource group.
Spec 016 T06: the control ledger's authoritative, independently recoverable Canada East copy region.
Public network access must be disabled (FR-05).
Private endpoint and private DNS are required (FR-05).

TaxAi__Production__Recovery__SqlPointInT.description: Spec 016 T06 (FR-11, AC-111): SQL short-term point-in-time retention, the 35-day maximum.

TaxAi__Production__Recovery__BackupChain.description: Spec 016 T06 (AC-103): the documented weekly full-backup chain kept beyond the retention period.

TaxAi__Production__Recovery__ControlLedg.description: Spec 016 T06 (FR-10, AC-103): [ASSUMED] control ledger immutability; strictly longer than 35 + 7 days.
